title: Research: screen heterogeneous spectral-radius application
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Screens the heterogeneous spectral-radius proposal against one exact repository interface. The toy matrix is genuinely contractive despite a row sum of `6/5`; an exact positive-vector witness is `v=(1,7/10)` with `rho=9/10`. This certificate pattern is already covered by the repository's A051/A052/A054 typed-recursion results.

The concrete 3|7 two-bank macro keeps all ten recursive child operations. Its exact `144`-ADD saving is only a finite phase-boundary toll, and selected-supplier assembly and analytic transfer are unproved. The evidence therefore supplies no actual `K(a)` and no κ improvement. This is a scoped negative applicability result, not an impossibility theorem for heterogeneous suppliers.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The user-assigned spectral-radius question refined the connector-alphabet card. The final overlap refresh covered 736 open PRs and 2,598 Discussions with complete pagination. It found the adjacent phase-dependent seed-switching discussion #2278 and local type-certificate/phase-accumulator results; those scopes are credited. The search does not inspect PR diffs or arbitrary package files, so novelty is not claimed.

## Validation

The registered package passed source-pin metadata checks and normal plus optimized CPython 3.12 replay:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/idea-a-spectral-radius-screen --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/idea-a-spectral-radius-screen
```

The verifier checks the rational toy contraction, a bad-weight control, the exact 3|7 boundary invoice, preservation of all ten children, and the cited theorem/candidate scope.

## Credit

The spectral-radius proposal is from the user's attached ten-idea note. Credit the A051/A052/A054/A056 results in `research/kappa-action-theory` and the exact 3|7 interface authors in `research/z4-hetero-two-bank-seedba18`. Prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

A useful continuation needs one named supplier with two genuinely recursive representation types, their child rank lists, all conversion/return costs, and a positive rational vector proving `M(a)v<v`. The screened macro does not supply those data.
